Guests can enjoy sailing on San Diego Bay with options for catering from local restaurants and a premium spirits bar. quotes.author: Sheryl Upkes
quotes.text: We had my birthday celebration yesterday on an Aolani catamaran. It was nothing short of SPECTACULAR. The crew was amazing and made sure we were having so much fun. Super attentive, etc. If you are considering a private Harbor tour, look no further, Aolani is perfect. Cameron was also very helpful, informative and gave great suggestions during the planning and reservation process to make the day perfect. Thank you! Sheryl and Bob

quotes.author: Chris Scotty
quotes.text: Can't recommend Aolani and the whole team highly enough! They were fantastic in helping our group plan an outing for a bachelor party. Made everything easy from start to finish and provided an exceptional experience on the water. Cameron, Holly and Joe from Aolani truly went above and beyond to make it a memorable day for our group can't say enough good things about them. Thank you team Aolani!

quotes.author: Debora Chlad
quotes.text: LOVED, LOVED, LOVED everything about this catamaran 3-hour cruise of the San Diego Bay! The staff were amazing. They were so patient, friendly, pleasant, said "yes" to all of our requests and made it feel like we were not on "their" boat, but were on "our" boat. Can't wait to go back because the boat was great, clean, plenty of seating, on deck and below, and the employees are a pleasure.

quotes.author: Belle Morales
quotes.text: We chartered the Aolani for a company event and everything was so smooth. From organizing the event and getting clear instructions to the day of set up by the crew was all great. Our clients loved it and our employees had a great relaxing time. We would most certainly recommend and rebook for future events.

quotes.author: alena abad
quotes.text: We have booked with Aolani a handful of times for corportate events.The staff are always so helpful and go the extra mile. Cameron ensures you have all the details necesarry prior to the trip. If you are debating, you should 100% give Aolani a try. 10/10 experience.

quotes.author: Sierra Blomquist
quotes.text: Amazing boat and crew:)! I had my 25th birthday on the boat with 45 guests, so much room to move around and enjoy the views. The team was awesome and so hospitable. We hope to sail with them again soon!

This “thank you” is long overdue. Thank you so much for a wonderful event on Aug.1. My associate DA only had wonderful things to say about you and your company. Please know that both he and I will recommend your company to others who will be traveling in that area. Looking forward to working with you in the future.

Had the chance to sail in the Aolani for a corp event last week. Bruno and Steven are great guys, easy to talk to and be around. Boat is nice and had plenty of room for our 20 or so. Sailing on the SD Bay in that boat makes for a unforgettable event.
